mapper.sql: s.id, s.user_id, s.title, s.kind, s.source, s.status, s.jangdan_id, j.name AS jangdan_name, s.bpm, s.bpm_unit, s.column_count, s.score_version, s.score_json, s.note_count, s.pending_cell_count, s.request_hash, s.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT id, bpm_unit FROM jangdans WHERE id = #{jangdanId}

SELECT s.jangdan_id, COALESCE(j.bpm_unit, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.score_json, '$.music.bpmUnit')), '') AS bpm_unit, s.score_json, s.is_scorable AS scorable FROM songs s LEFT JOIN jangdans j ON j.id = s.jangdan_id WHERE s.id = #{songId} AND s.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_sheets (user_id, title, kind, source, status, jangdan_id, bpm, bpm_unit, column_count, score_json, note_count, idempotency_key, request_hash, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{kind}, #{source}, #{status}, #{jangdanId}, #{bpm}, #{bpmUnit}, #{columnCount}, #{scoreJson}, #{noteCount}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestHash}, #{createdAt}, #{createdAt})
